text.p: Cotton Valley Resources Corp said Monday it closed on about $1,537,000 of financing since late June, which will be used for acquisitions and property development.

The company said the financing was comprised of $704,000 in short and long term secured notes, $379,000 of options exercised by existing shareholders and the company's former investment banker and a $454,000 private placement of restricted stock and warrants.

The company also said it chose to exchange its 25 percent interest in the 1200 acre Movico Field Prospect, in Alabama for a $3 million reduction in purchase price related to its option to buy a 51.6 percent interest in the Sword Field, offshore from Santa Barbara, Calif.
Cotton Valley is an independent oil and gas company with interests in Texas, Oklahoma, and Utah.
